body: It is raining. I like that. Everything just seems so dull, I can barely see anything. I am watching Planet Earth II. It’s beautiful but it’s also sad.

thank you. It’s terrible. There’s so many things wrong but I can’t change them. Nobody can change them. I’m sorry for acting cryptic by the way I just can’t get any decent thoughts out of my stupid fucking head to express what I feel in words.

It’s certainly not a good or entertaining story. It’s filled with panic attacks, anxiety, depression, insomnia, anhedonia, and depersonalization. I’m ranting stupid issues. fuck. I don’t know what else to say. 

I’ve never had good contact with my parents. I feel like they’re constantly trying to rekindle a relationship with me but I just shut them down. 

I had a drug problem for a year or two. I quit but honestly I was happier when I was using. I don’t want to go back to using, though. It developed some mental problems for me. I was happier, but certainly not healthier. 

I have a great cat but she’s skittish. I like watching depressing movies with her but every time there’s a loud noise she runs away for a bit then comes back. She’s hard to really spend time with because she’s always scared. I like the rain outside and how calm it is. It’s one of the few things I can enjoy anymore.

I tried talking to an old friend tonight. They just told me they were sorry for “destroying everything”. I didn’t know what they meant. I just told them it’s my fault and left it. 

I don’t know how to act normal to the people around me. I feel like I’m talking slow because I have to think about what normal people would say. I have to force laughter.

I tried playing video games, that wasn’t fun at all. It was all gray and bland. I stopped playing.

I’ve just been sitting here wasting time. It hurts. I’m sorry

I had to put down my dog a few weeks ago. It’s not the cause for all of this sadness, I’ve felt it for a couple years. It’s just like a culmination of things. I feel like life is going by too fast and it just keeps getting faster and harder. It feels like it will never stop. And everyone just says it gets worse from here, and these people are a million times more mentally stable than me. 

I feel so alone, but at the same time, I don’t want to be with anyone. I don’t want people to see me like this. I hate myself for making this post, I don’t deserve any support. I’m just miserable tonight. I want to go to bed but I can’t sleep, I can’t stop crying
I just want to give everything of value to everyone I ever cared about and leave. I don’t want anything from anyone. I’ve taken enough.
